request.purpose: Policy-making: planning hospital capacity and care pathways for the coming years.
request.question: How many patients with heart failure and atrial fibrillation take both a beta blocker and an anticoagulant?
definitions: Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Beta blocker = ATC code starting with C07AB.
Oral anticoagulant = ATC code starting with B01AA or B01AF.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report: patients with heart failure and atrial fibrillation, and how many of them have both an active beta blocker and an active oral anticoagulant.
